name: sql_keywords
description: Fill missing SQL clause keywords in query fragments; controls extract table names from the same fragments.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
forms=[('___ name FROM {t};','SELECT'),('SELECT name ___ {t};','FROM'),('SELECT name FROM {t} ___ active = 1;','WHERE'),('SELECT name FROM {t} ORDER ___ name;','BY'),('SELECT name FROM {t} ___ BY name;','ORDER'),('SELECT role, SUM(salary) FROM {t} ___ BY role;','GROUP'),('SELECT a.name FROM {t} a INNER ___ teams b ON a.team = b.id;','JOIN'),('SELECT ___ name FROM {t};','DISTINCT')]
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(96):
 t=random.choice(['staff','users','employees','members','people','students']);f,ans=forms[i%len(forms)];p='SQL query: '+f.format(t=t)+'\n'
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Fill ___ with the correct uppercase SQL keyword. Answer:','answer':' '+ans})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'Write the main table name (not teams). Answer:','answer':' '+t})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
